title: Skill review attestation v1
description: Evidence that a reviewer (human or agent) checked a skill's claims against its sources. See REVIEWING.md. An attestation never promotes a skill by itself; a maintainer does.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the skill file bytes, CRLF normalised to LF.

github.description: Must equal the pull request author.

content_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the response body as fetched. Pages change, so a mismatch is a flag for a maintainer, not proof of fabrication.

claim.description: A concrete claim copied verbatim from the skill (command, flag, number, behaviour).

source_url.description: One of sources[].url. Required for confirmed and contradicted.

evidence_quote.description: Text copied from the source that supports or contradicts the claim. Must appear in the re-fetched page.

coverage.description: How the claims were chosen, e.g. every command and flag.

attestation_sha256.description: SHA-256 of this document's canonical JSON (sorted keys, no spaces) without this field. Tamper evidence only.
